Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Islamic Heritage and Civilisation
Topic 7.1: Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya
2. Practise Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya in the examples.
2. Explain Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya
2. Practise Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Islam in Kenya • Coast • Western • Central • North Eastern Kenya
